summary: Melco Resorts filed a 6-K press release announcing the extension of its HK$15.2B (≈US$1.94B) revolving credit facility maturity from Apr 2027 to Jun 2031 and establishment of an incremental HK$6.4B (≈US$821.6M) facility, raising total commitments to HK$21.7B (≈US$2.77B). The amendment was via a third amended and restated agreement dated June 9, 2026, with unchanged pricing/covenants and customary fees paid to consenting lenders. As a routine debt refinancing without change of control or equity involvement, it does not constitute a special situation. No risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst.
